recommendation: Keep the commit. Any future OO decision to move Observation.$stats to an API Incubator IG should be handled separately because the current core build still publishes this operation.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO issue asking to clarify Observation.$stats by consistently using the `statistic` parameter, adding skew/kurtosis/regression, avoiding unauthorized observations, and addressing unit variations.
initial_application: Commit a4bc03f16720aa6553cbff8e798d1585f5a63ed5 applied FHIR-12452 in the legacy Observation spreadsheet with statistic naming, authorization text, and added statistic codes. Later refactor 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 created current OperationDefinition/CodeSystem source, but unit guidance was still absent and examples retained stale min/max values despite the required CodeSystem using minimum/maximum.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and list-Observation-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Observation-stats. FHIR-10041 created the original $stats operation and statistic code system; FHIR-9964 was only a same-commit lastn issue. Community searches found no later applied decision that supersedes FHIR-12452 for the current core build.
reconciliation: Updated source/observation/operationdefinition-Observation-stats.xml with common UCUM unit handling and corrected statistic parameter documentation; updated $stats request/response examples to use maximum/minimum codes from the required CodeSystem.
source_changes: source/observation/operationdefinition-Observation-stats.xml: added common-UCUM-unit guidance to footer/comment and changed the statistic parameter summary to average|maximum|minimum|count.
source/observation/$stats-request.txt: changed the example request to use statistic=minimum and statistic=maximum.
source/observation/$stats-response.txt: changed example component codes from min/max to minimum/maximum.
